probes.rationale: Presence opt-out hides the surveillance surfaces, never published knowledge (DESIGN.md 2.1, services/visibility.ts): the evidence-backed claim still hints, attributed to its author.

The owner's decision on the batch-2 integration review's I1: an opted-out developer's live session on the file is still a collision, told anonymously (server services/hints.ts listAnonymousTargetPresence, visibility.ts «anonymous»). The ask is pointer-class with nothing to point at: 'A teammate is working on <file> right now', no name, branch, age or context id — so no expectContextId, and the namelessness itself is pinned by connector-claude test/collision-anonymous-hook.test.ts and the release gate's I1 case. Silence here was the pilot's failure recreated for every opted-out person.
